title: candidate.json, contract 1
description: Contract of a migrabench candidate, written by the AI agent at the root of the candidate folder. The folder also holds package.json and package-lock.json. No URL and no port: the bench imposes the port through the PORT variable.

$schema.description: Address of this schema, for the editor. Ignored by the bench.

build.description: Command run with sh -c after npm ci, in the build phase. Optional.

start.description: Command run with sh -c in the start phase. It must listen on the PORT variable.
